rules.narrative_template: For D4342, clinical documentation shows pocket depths of 4mm or greater on at least 2 teeth per quadrant, bleeding on probing, and radiographic evidence of bone loss. These findings support medical necessity for SRP.

For D2950, the tooth has less than 50% remaining coronal structure after decay removal, and a crown is planned. The core buildup restores structural integrity and provides retention for the definitive crown.
